notes.title: Halloween Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy Halloween![/b][/h1]

This update brings halloween themed changes! Some effects may look spookier, and all the creatures have halloween costumes that can be toggled on or off!
A new spooky halloween effect has been added as well.
